Edit.Title: Preset Editor
Edit.Subtitle: Create your own preset with ReShade, live on map screenshots. When you're happy with it, save it to your library.

Edit.HowTo: In the editor press Home to open ReShade: tick the effects you want and move their sliders. Every change is saved automatically. Press Print Screen to take the screenshot that will be the preset's preview, then close the window (ESC) when you're done.

Edit.ProposeInfo:
Your preset will be packed into a .zip with its screenshot and description, and its folder will open.

Then GitHub opens with a ready-made submission: drag the .zip into the text box and press Create. You need a free GitHub account; you can also share the .zip on our Discord.

Hotkeys.Title: IN-GAME SHORTCUTS
Hotkeys.Text: Switch preset during a match with one key, without opening ReShade. Choose a preset, click the key box and press the key you want (Ctrl, Shift and Alt work too).
Hotkeys.KeyTip: Click and press a key. Backspace clears it.
Hotkeys.FavoritesTip: Give F5–F11 to your favorite presets
Hotkeys.ApplyTip: Write the shortcuts into the game again (needed if it was open when you changed them)
Hotkeys.Note: Avoid Home (opens ReShade) and keys you use in game. The presets are copied into the game folder so ReShade can find them.
Hotkeys.Duplicate: Two shortcuts use the same key: only the first one will work.
Hotkeys.NoFavorites: You have no favorite presets yet: star some on the Install page.
Hotkeys.Applied: Saved and applied to the game ({0}).
Hotkeys.NoGame: No game found: shortcuts are saved and will be applied when the game is found.
Hotkeys.NoReShade: ReShade isn't installed yet: install a preset first, the shortcuts are applied with it.
Hotkeys.GameRunning: The game is open: close it and press Apply to the game (ReShade would overwrite them when it closes).
Hotkeys.Failed: The shortcuts could not be written into the game folder (see the log).
Report.Title: Report a problem
Report.Subtitle: Tell us what went wrong: the report reaches the developer as a GitHub issue. No account needed.
Report.WhatHint: What were you doing, what did you expect and what happened instead? Any error message helps.
Report.ContactHint: Discord name or e-mail, if you'd like to be contacted. It will be public on GitHub.
Report.IncludeLog: Attach today's log (recommended: it shows what the app did)
Report.Privacy: The report becomes a public issue on GitHub. Your Windows user name is removed from paths and from the log. Nothing else is collected.
Report.DiscordTip: Open Discord and the logs folder instead
Report.SentText: The developer has been notified. You can follow the report on GitHub.
Report.TooManyText: Only a few reports a day can be sent from the same network. Try again tomorrow, or use GitHub or Discord.
Report.FailedText: The report service can't be reached right now (maybe you're offline). You can open the report on GitHub (with an account) or ask on Discord.
Overlay.Title: STREAMER OVERLAY
Overlay.Text: Show your viewers that you use DBD Reshade, and which preset is active. It updates by itself when you switch preset in game.
Overlay.Address: Address to add in OBS / Streamlabs
Overlay.Copied: Address copied: paste it into a Browser source.
Overlay.PreviewTip: Open the overlay in the browser
Overlay.Error: The overlay couldn't start on port {0}: try another port. {1}
Overlay.OnlyWhilePlaying: Only while Dead by Daylight is open
Overlay.PortTip: Change it only if another program already uses 7373
Overlay.TextFile: Also write it to a text file (for a "Text" source)
Overlay.Obs: In OBS: Sources → + → Browser → paste the address, width 600, height 100. The background is transparent. The app must stay open while you stream.
Overlay.HiddenNow: Hidden right now: Dead by Daylight is closed (it appears when you start the game, or untick "Only while Dead by Daylight is open").
